prompt:
Precise LOCAL EDIT of the three hovering talismans in this character artwork. Replace the three PAPER TALISMANS completely with THREE FLOATING ELEMENTAL LIGHT ORBS. Keep the entire character identity, youthful face, actual head/body proportions, hands, pose, clothing, hair, antennas, yin-yang clasp, huge butterfly cloak and two long tails, existing gem-icon painting and plain ivory background unchanged in design.

Exactly THREE small elemental energy spheres hover above her raised palm, in the same loose triangular/fan arrangement as the old talismans, with clear space between spheres and between spheres and the hand/head:
LEFT / LOWER = golden-yellow LIGHTNING ORB, a solid round yellow-gold energy body with ONE bold angular lightning-shaped bright core and deep violet-gold shadow plane.
CENTER / HIGHER = orange-red FIRE ORB, a rounded orange-red energy body with ONE simple yellow-white flame core and just 2–3 short curved flame tongues along its upper edge.
RIGHT = pale-cyan ICE ORB, a rounded ice-blue energy body with ONE simple stout six-armed snow-crystal core and a few broad icy-blue shaded planes.
The orbs should have approximately equal visual size, about the width of each former talisman paper, and feel gently levitating as a coherent magical trio. Color AND central silhouette make them immediately distinguishable. No extra fourth orb.

Paint them in the SAME PROJECT GEM ICON language: strong clean dark colored outline, 2–3 broad light/shadow shapes, one concentrated luminous core and a very small crisp bright rim. Subtle light only, no huge blurry bloom, realistic glass reflection, photorealistic refraction, particle shower, electrical spaghetti, dense small facets or surrounding magic circles. Keep the warm ivory background clean. Their spherical volume is readable but stylized and hand-painted, not flat circle badges.
Remove ALL old paper rectangles, paper borders, red seals, talisman text and calligraphy. These are pure elemental energy orbs, not icons pasted onto cards. Keep the hand completely unobscured. No other changes to the character or composition, no new objects, captions, crop or collage. Output the same full-body square artwork with only this local object replacement.
purpose: Replace the three talisman papers with distinct lightning, fire and ice light orbs in the same gem-icon painting style.
visual_review: Three paper slips removed and replaced by gold lightning, orange-red fire and blue ice orbs. Character design and full silhouette retained.
